en.title: lemo-animi · stop-motion shorts from one line, made with Codex
en.desc: Make a stop-motion short from one line with Codex. Claude Code with an image model works too. Eight materials, an original score and a review page for your notes.
en.lede: Tell Codex a story in one sentence and pick a material. It draws the puppets and sets, moves them in code frame by frame, scores the film and opens a review page for your notes. Claude Code with an image model works too.
en.ask: Make a 40-second clay stop-motion about a penguin learning to flip pancakes.
en.films_p: Each one made by the skill on its own, from one sentence. Chinese narration and subtitles.
en.styles_p: Each style is a fixed package: prompt templates, lighting, camera grammar, score and foley.
how: It asks everything at once
Whatever your sentence left out (style, story, length, size, narration, title cards) in one set of questions, defaults first. Then it works through to the end.
It plans
A story skeleton with seconds per part, beats, a shot list and an image list.
It generates the pictures
Character sheets, backgrounds, 8-cell action sheets and 2×2 close-up sheets on transparent backgrounds, in one material.
It animates in code
The sheets are cut into cells and timed on twos or threes, with camera moves, contact shadows, light and grade.
It adds sound
An original score from real instrument samples, foley on every contact, optional narration and subtitles.
You review
A local review page: pause on any moment and write a note; it fixes every note until you approve.
en.install_p: Two commands in Codex. Claude Code works too: one line in the chat.
en.install_link: Full install guide: updates, removal, manual install
en.foot: Every frame on this page comes from a sample film the skill made by itself.
en.kicker: Made with Codex · Claude Code works too
en.cast_p: Eight materials, eight leads, each from its sample film. Point at one and it turns round, one drawing at a time.
en.loop_note: Muted 6-second loop. The full film has the score, foley and narration.
en.proc_h: Images make it look right. Code makes it move.
en.proc_p: The image model never draws a moving picture. It draws sheets; Python cuts them into cells and times them on twos, over a background, with shadows, light and camera.
proc: Front, three-quarter, side and back, in the style’s material.
Eight poses of one action, on a transparent background.
An empty set, drawn from the shot’s camera angle.
The action cells timed on twos over the set, with shadow, light and camera.
en.steps_h: From one line to a film
install_steps: Codex: run both in a terminal, then start a new chat. Claude Code: type the line in the chat, then /reload-plugins, and make films in auto mode (Shift+Tab).
The first time, it installs the Python environment and the instrument samples (about 1.7 GB) before it asks anything, and starts asking once they check out.
en.need: You need macOS or Linux, ffmpeg, and Python 3.11–3.13 or uv. Codex draws the pictures with its built-in image generation. In Claude Code they come from the Codex CLI on the same machine, or from your own image tool (experimental).
more: 99 film styles made entirely in code.
One picture in, a seamless loop of about five seconds out.
en.review_p: When the film is ready, the agent opens a review page in your browser: the film above a strip of its shots.
review_pts: Write a note where it happens
Pause on the moment and press Enter. The time, frame and shot are attached, and a pin marks the note on the strip.
The agent works through every note, replies under each one with what it changed, and adds the next version. The page asks you to reload.
When it looks right, click Approve and the agent delivers the film.
en.review_wait: The top of the page shows whether the agent is waiting for you, for up to 30 minutes. If time runs out, nothing is lost: notes are saved as you write. When you are done, click Send or Approve and tell the agent in the chat.
en.review_alt: The review page: the film paused at 0:18.40, three notes pinned on the film strip, one marked Fixed with the agent's reply
en.model: Recommended in Codex: GPT-6.2 Sol or GPT-6.2 Astra, reasoning High or above. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra work too.
licence_pts: Share and adapt it, with credit to lemo-animi by Lemomo (LemoLab). For films, the credit is enough, no link needed.
So does using films made with lemo-animi commercially: advertising, client work, monetised channels, products.

If you are an individual and your creator income over the last 12 months is no more than CNY 50,000 (USD 7,000 if most of it is in other currencies), you can earn from lemo-animi films on your own accounts, with credit. Client work is not included.
Source Han Sans (OFL 1.1) and the instrument samples keep their own licences. Narration uses Microsoft Edge voices, under Microsoft’s terms.

zh.title: lemo-animi · 用 Codex 一句话做一支定格动画
zh.desc: 用 Codex 一句话做一支定格动画短片；Claude Code 配一个生图模型也能做。八种材质，原创配乐，还有审片台等你写意见。
zh.h1: {一句话，做一支}{定格动画短片}
zh.lede: 用一句话跟 Codex {说个故事}、{挑一种材质}：{它用自带的生图}{画出角色和布景}，在代码里{一格一格地}让它们动起来，{配好乐}，{再打开审片台}{等你写意见}。Claude Code 配一个{生图模型}也能做。
zh.ask: 做一支 40 秒的{黏土定格动画}：{小企鹅学做煎饼}。
zh.films_p: 每一支都是 skill 自己从一句话做出来的，中文旁白和字幕。
zh.styles_p: 每种风格是一个固定的{风格包}：提示词模板、光线、机位写法、配乐和拟音。
how: 开工前一次问完
你那句话没说到的（风格、故事、时长、画幅、旁白、片头片尾）放在一组问题里，默认项排第一；之后一路做到成片。
先定方案
故事骨架和每段秒数、节拍、镜头表、生图清单。
生图
角色设定、背景、八格动作表、2×2 近景表，透明底，全按同一种材质。
代码让它动
动作表切成一格一格，一拍二或一拍三排时间，加运镜、接触阴影、光和调色。
配声音
真实乐器采样写的原创配乐，每个接触都有拟音；需要的话加旁白和字幕。
你来审
本地审片台：停在哪一刻就在哪写意见，它逐条改完，直到你点通过。
zh.install_p: Codex 里两条命令。Claude Code 也能用：{在对话里输入一句。}
zh.install_link: 完整安装说明：更新、卸载、手动安装
zh.foot: 这一页的每一帧都来自 skill 自己做的样片。
zh.kicker: 用 Codex 来做 · Claude Code 也能用
zh.cast_p: 八种材质，八位主角，都来自各自的样片。{把鼠标放上去}（{手机上点一下}），它会{一格一格}转过身。
zh.loop_note: 这里是 6 秒静音循环；完整样片有配乐、拟音和旁白。
zh.proc_h: 图负责好看，代码负责动
zh.proc_p: 生图模型从不画会动的画面，它只画「表」：角色设定、动作表、空背景。Python 把表切成一格一格，一拍二排在背景上，加阴影、光和运镜。
proc: 正面、四分之三、侧面、背面，全按风格的材质。
一个动作的八个姿势，透明底。
空的布景，按这个镜头的机位画。
动作表的格子一拍二排在布景上，再加阴影、光和运镜。
install_steps: Codex 在终端里运行，装好后新开一个对话。Claude Code 直接在对话里输入，再 /reload-plugins；做片子时按 Shift+Tab 切到 auto 模式。
第一次用时，一开工先装 Python 运行环境和乐器采样（约 1.7 GB），检查通过了再开始提问。
zh.need: 需要 macOS 或 Linux、ffmpeg，以及 Python 3.11–3.13 或 uv。Codex 用自带的生图画图；在 Claude Code 里，图由本机的 Codex CLI 来画，也可以接你自己的生图工具（实验功能）。
more: 99 种影片风格，全部用代码做。
一张图进去，出来一段约 5 秒的无缝循环。
给 Claude Code 换皮肤，21 种风格。
zh.review_p: 片子做好后，agent 会在浏览器里打开审片台：上面是片子，下面是一格一格的胶片。
review_pts: 停在要改的那一刻按回车。时间码、帧号和镜头自动带上，胶片上钉一枚图钉。
agent 逐条去改，在每条意见下回复改了什么，再登记新的一版，页面提示你刷新。
满意了点「通过」，agent 交片。
zh.review_pill: agent 在等你 · 还剩 26 分钟
zh.review_wait: 页面顶上显示 agent 是不是在等你，最多等 30 分钟。过了时间什么都不会丢：意见边写边存。写完点「提交」或「通过」，再回对话说一声就行。
zh.review_alt: 审片台：片子停在 0:18.40，胶片上钉着三条意见，第一条已经标了「已改」和 agent 的回复
zh.model: Codex 里推荐 GPT-6.2 Sol 或 GPT-6.2 Astra，推理强度 High 及以上；GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Astra 也可以。
licence_pts: 可以分享、改编，署名 lemo-animi by Lemomo (LemoLab)。用它做的影片署名就够，不用附链接。
用 lemo-animi 做的影片拿去商用也一样：广告、接单、带变现的频道、产品。
自媒体创作者变现免费
个人创作者过去12个月的自媒体收入不超过5万元人民币（收入主要不是人民币的按7,000美元），可以在自己的账号上用 lemo-animi 做的影片变现，记得署名。给客户接单不在内。
思源黑体（OFL 1.1）和乐器采样保留各自的许可证。旁白用微软 Edge 在线语音，遵守微软的条款。

story.en: A little penguin wants to flip the perfect pancake. Two tries fail; eyes shut, the third works, and the one stuck to the ceiling drops onto the mouse.
story.zh: 小企鹅波波想抛出一张完美的煎饼，两次都失败，闭上眼第三次成了；粘在天花板上的那张掉下来，正好给了小老鼠。

en: A character learning one thing, succeeding on the third try
zh: 角色学一件事，第三次成功

en: Stories set mostly in the dark or at night
zh: 大半在黑暗或夜里的故事

story.en: A fox sails out with a paper lantern and a wave knocks it into the sea. In the dark, a whale lifts it back up: the whale is afraid of the dark too.
story.zh: 小狐狸提着纸灯笼出海，一个浪把灯打进海里；漆黑里，大鲸鱼把灯顶了回来。原来鲸鱼也怕黑。

en: A small character in frame with something huge
zh: 小角色和一个巨大的东西同框

en: Scenes that need to orbit the character or see it from behind
Stories needing lots of soft materials (cloth, fur, water) that deform delicately
zh: 要绕着角色转或从背后拍的场面
要很多会细腻变形的软材料（布、毛、水）的故事

story.en: A tin elephant balances a ball in the circus after closing. On the highest throw its spring runs down, and it stops, tilted, just as the ball lands on its trunk.
story.zh: 打烊后的铁皮马戏团，小象顶球；抛得最高的那一下发条松了，它一顿一顿停住，球正好落在歪着的鼻尖上。

en: Stories of running down, stopping, and being wound up again
zh: 发条松了、停下、又被上紧的故事

en: Subtle facial acting (faces are printed and cannot deform)
Scenes needing fluid, soft movement (tumbling, running, hugging)
zh: 细腻的面部表演（脸是印上去的，不会变形）
要流畅柔软动作的场面（翻滚、奔跑、拥抱）

title.en: A Lamp on a Snowy Night

story.en: A rabbit leaves its lamp with a squirrel who is afraid of the dark and walks home blind. Then a light comes up behind it.
story.zh: 小兔子把灯留给怕黑的小松鼠，自己摸黑回家；走不动的时候，身后亮起了光。

en: Giving gifts, waiting for someone to come home, caring for others
zh: 送礼物、等人回家、照顾别人

en: Fast slapstick, comedy with big squash-and-stretch
Hard, shiny materials (metal, glass, water) in the lead
Lots of smoke and translucent effects
zh: 快节奏闹剧、大幅压扁拉长的喜剧
刺眼的白天、热闹的高饱和场面
以金属、玻璃、水这类硬亮材质为主
大量烟雾和半透明特效

story.en: A cardboard astronaut lands on the Moon and salutes the flag. Then the camera pulls back: the bedroom floor. Distance flown: thirty centimetres.
story.zh: 纸箱宇航员登上月球、插旗敬礼；镜头一拉开，原来都在卧室地板上，「实际飞行距离：三十厘米」。

zh: 喜剧短片、一本正经的小冒险

en: Scenes needing delicate soft materials (cloth, water, fur)
zh: 要细腻软材料（布、水、毛）的场面

story.en: A newly carved wooden bear wakes under an oil lamp, learns to stand and runs back from the dark. When the flame sinks, it turns the lamp up, and finds a wooden rabbit waking too.
story.zh: 刚刻好的小木熊在油灯下醒来，学站、被黑吓回来；灯芯矮下去时它拧亮了灯，光里还有一只小木兔也醒了。

en: Objects and toys coming to life
zh: 安静的温暖、孤独与陪伴

en: Comedy needing soft deformation and exaggerated expressions
Soft things such as water, fire or cloth in the lead
zh: 要软变形和夸张表情的喜剧
以水、火、布这类软东西为主

story.en: A pufferfish scares off the little fish every time it gets excited and puffs up. When a big current comes, it puffs up on purpose and they all hide behind it.
story.zh: 小河豚一激动就鼓成刺球，把小鱼全吓跑；大水流卷来时它主动鼓起来，小鱼们全躲到了它身后。

en: Small creatures of the seabed, gardens, ponds
Making friends, a band of companions
zh: 海底、花园、池塘里的小生物

en: Stories needing crisp, hard-edged action (fights, machines)
zh: 要干脆硬朗动作的故事（打斗、机器）

story.en: The last duckling in line gets lost, follows a seam of stitches across the patchwork fields and hops over the river on buttons. For once, it arrives first.
story.zh: 走在最后的小鸭走散了，顺着一道针脚穿过拼布田野、踩着纽扣过河；这一回，第一个到池塘的是它。

en: Stories of setting out, travelling, looking for something
A band of companions moving in a line
zh: 出发、旅行、找东西的故事
排成一串走路的一群伙伴

en: Night scenes, dark tones, tense thrilling subjects
Fast fights, comedy with big deformation
Stories set entirely in one small room (wastes the fields)
zh: 夜景、暗色调、紧张刺激的题材
整个故事都在一个小房间里（浪费了田野）
